decision_rule: INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE below 10 participants; otherwise PASS only when every primary endpoint accuracy is at least 0.8
privacy: Collect a random participant id only. Do not collect names, contacts, biometrics, government identifiers, or free-text personal data.
claim_boundary: Packet validation is engineering readiness. No usability claim exists until at least ten real unfamiliar participants complete the answer-blind packet.
